system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: storage-keyring
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings
  properties:
    parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]/locations/us-central1
    keyRingId: storage-encryption-keyring

- name: storage-encryption-key
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.storage-keyring.name)
    cryptoKeyId: storage-encryption-key
    purpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
    rotationPeriod: 7776000s
    nextRotationTime: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    versionTemplate:
      algorithm: GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION
      protectionLevel: SOFTWARE

- name: kms-encrypter-binding
  action: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:cloudkms.projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy
  properties:
    resource: $(ref.storage-encryption-key.name)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
        members:
        - serviceAccount:service-[PROJECT_NUMBER]@gs-project-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com

- name: encrypted-storage-bucket
  type: storage.v1.bucket
  properties:
    name: [PROJECT_ID]-encrypted-data
    location: US-CENTRAL1
    storageClass: STANDARD
    uniformBucketLevelAccess:
      enabled: true
    publicAccessPrevention: enforced
    versioning:
      enabled: true
    encryption:
      defaultKmsKeyName: $(ref.storage-encryption-key.name)
    iamConfiguration:
      uniformBucketLevelAccess:
        enabled: true
    lifecycle:
      rule:
      - action:
          type: SetStorageClass
          storageClass: NEARLINE
        condition:
          age: 30
      - action:
          type: SetStorageClass
          storageClass: COLDLINE
        condition:
          age: 90
      - action:
          type: Delete
        condition:
          age: 365
          isLive: false
    logging:
      logBucket: [PROJECT_ID]-access-logs
      logObjectPrefix: encrypted-data-access
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - kms-encrypter-binding

outputs:
- name: keyRingName
  value: $(ref.storage-keyring.name)
- name: cryptoKeyName
  value: $(ref.storage-encryption-key.name)
- name: bucketName
  value: $(ref.encrypted-storage-bucket.name)
